description: Lists the selected wedding's events in date order with their dates, times, venues, dress codes and descriptions. Optional filters narrow results by event type or by a range of calendar days in the wedding's time zone; the total counts the events returned. Each event names the other events whose times overlap it. Requires sign-in.

from.description: First day to include, as YYYY-MM-DD in the wedding's time zone.

to.description: Last day to include, as YYYY-MM-DD in the wedding's time zone.

type.description: Filter by event type, one type or a list such as ["ceremony", "reception"].

wedding_id.description: Identifier of a wedding the signed-in account can manage. Required when the account has multiple weddings.

name: list_my_events
title: List My Wedding Events
